items.name: Brand slab nudge
items.description: Over the footage, an ink 'QN' monogram tile drops into the bottom-left corner. A lime slab wipes out of it with 'QUILLFERN NOTES / Subscribe for more →'. The arrow keeps nudging until the slab folds back into the tile.

items.name: Paper tab nudge
items.description: A cobalt 'IP' tile sits bottom-right and a paper tab slides out of it saying 'Subscribe'. The line rolls up to 'A new build every Friday' while the tab widens to fit, and a cobalt timer bar runs along its foot.

items.name: Brand panel end screen
items.description: A 12 s end-screen clip. A lime panel rises with 'Keep watching' and a 'QN' subscribe circle with a turning dotted ring. Two hatched 16:9 slots with lime crop marks stack on ink.

items.name: Paper sheet end screen
items.description: A paper sheet with a cobalt leading band rises over the last shot. It shows 'Thanks for watching', two 16:9 slots side by side, and the 'Subscribe →' label with the 'IP' circle bottom-right.
